summary: Tested new 'Ospitalità & Pasti' feature end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (aggregation, single/bulk CRUD for lodgings & meals, group delete, error handling, cost visibility for admin, individual-override precedence, regression on events/persons/staff/companies). Frontend: full UI flow works — login, sidebar nav to /ospitalita, event selector switches to Tech Summit Milano showing 4 person rows, all 7 summary cards render, person plan dialog opens with lodging add/edit/delete, meal add via meal-tipo dropdown, esigenze editor saves. Three views (persona/giorno/struttura), filters, and bulk-assign dialog render and submit. AI chat widget 'Chiedi a CRMEvent' still visible (regression OK).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking bulk-assign-submit (colazione, select-all), the 'summary-colazioni' card kept showing 0 in the immediate re-read; the per-giorno view then had no day-select and per-struttura had 0 cards. Backend /api/meals/bulk endpoint works correctly (verified by pytest); this may be a UI state refetch race after the bulk dialog closes, OR the automation clicked bulk-select-all after the meal-tipo dropdown closed and the count actually was 0 in that specific run. Worth a manual verification by main agent.

action_items: Manually verify bulk assignment updates the summary cards immediately (may need to add a refetch/mutate call after bulk-assign submit closes the dialog).
Consider ensuring the /ospitalita per-giorno tab shows an empty-state hint when no lodgings/meals exist (currently day-select simply doesn't render).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 664: can_costs = admin.get('role') == 'admin'. Since require_admin already gates admin+member, this correctly redacts cost fields for member users. Redaction path only triggers when role != 'admin'. Consider adding a member test user for full coverage.

Lodging/Meal models have persona_id + evento_id as required strings but no validation that the person is actually linked to the event via staff. Bulk endpoints resolve via staff, but single POST /api/lodgings and /api/meals accept any pair. Minor.
crud_routes list endpoint filters by evento_id only when provided; a global GET /api/lodgings without filters returns ALL lodgings across events — fine for admin but consider pagination.
seed_data_creation: Test lodgings/meals created during pytest were cleaned up via module teardown and inline deletes. UI test also removed created bulk meals via per-person delete.
